_comment: Layout search (simscale_layout.py): a Gaussian-process model over the numbers marked 'evolve' in layout_params.json; every legal layout is scored on it each round, 8 go to CFD.
rules: no wheel supports (added later, their mass counted); cargo and tether guides on; milled top and bottom, 3.175 mm ball, 3 mm walls (Part 1); sidepod top <= 27.175 mm; road 0.15 mm under the wheels; lead to 48.2 g
